nodes.label: INV-1: storeIsolation Middleware (Multi-Tenancy)
nodes.rationale: Multi-tenancy is enforced by middleware injecting req.storeId/req.store instead of separate databases; every store-scoped controller query must use req.storeId, never req.user.store directly. Master Admin may override via ?storeId=<uuid> after UUID validation.

nodes.label: INV-2: Atomic Stock Operations (MongoDB Transactions)
nodes.rationale: Any stock deduction/transfer/reversal/adjustment uses mongoose.startSession()+startTransaction(); the session is created in the controller and passed to the service to allow composition. Without atomicity, stock balances become inconsistent and COGS/financial data wrong (ADR-0002).

nodes.label: INV-3: JWT in httpOnly Cookie
nodes.rationale: JWT lives in an httpOnly cookie (not localStorage) for XSS protection; token expiresIn 1d while cookie persists 30d (refresh endpoint not implemented). tokenVerification.js also accepts Authorization: Bearer for mobile/PDV clients.

nodes.label: INV-4: Dynamic RBAC Roles per Module
nodes.rationale: Roles are dynamic documents with per-module CRUD permission flags plus customPermissions, not hardcoded strings. userModel.role is Mixed (ObjectId or legacy String) as a transitional state until migration P2-01 normalizes all to ObjectId.
nodes.norm_label: inv-4: dynamic rbac roles per module

nodes.label: INV-5: Fire-and-Forget Audit Logging
nodes.rationale: auditService.logAudit catches all errors and returns null; in a running restaurant an audit failure must NEVER block a sale or stock transfer (ADR-0005).

nodes.label: Hard/Soft Error Policy (Stock Deduction)
nodes.rationale: Hard errors (insufficient balance in strict mode, missing store stock location) abort the transaction; soft errors (product without recipe, missing optional ingredient) proceed with stockDeductionStatus='partial' and a stockDeductionReason warning, so payment/closure is not blocked by mapping gaps.

nodes.label: stockImpactType Product Rules
nodes.rationale: Products declare how they hit stock: recipe_derived (dynamic via linked recipe), stock_item_direct (1 unit of associated item), industrialized_resale (no fractional ingredient deduction).

nodes.label: Stock Reversal Mechanism (sale_reversal)
nodes.rationale: Cancellation compensates original sale_deduction StockMovements with inverse sale_reversal movements inside a Mongoose session, restoring StockBalance and setting stockReversalStatus='reversed'.

nodes.label: MongoDB Replica Set Requirement
nodes.rationale: Transactions in orderCheckoutService.js require MongoDB running as a Replica Set; Atlas M0 includes RS, plain local mongod does not (must use --replSet rs0 + rs.initiate()).

nodes.label: UUID v4 Immutable Business ID Pattern
nodes.rationale: Every main model defines an immutable String business identifier (default uuidv4, unique, indexed) alongside Mongo's _id, giving readable stable IDs decoupled from ObjectId.
nodes.norm_label: uuid v4 immutable business id pattern

nodes.label: Multi-Tenant store Field Scoping in Models
nodes.rationale: Store-scoped models carry a required, indexed ObjectId ref to Store; this field is what store isolation filters (getStoreFilter) rely on for tenant separation.
nodes.norm_label: multi-tenant store field scoping in models

nodes.label: mongodb-memory-server Test Isolation
nodes.rationale: Tests run against an in-memory MongoDB via Jest globalSetup; no test may depend on a physically running MongoDB instance.

nodes.label: verify.sh Unified Verification Script
nodes.rationale: Single local gate before commit: 10 checks covering prerequisites, required files, .env safety, hardcoded secrets scan, node_modules, app.js import, Jest run, package.json script mapping, ADR presence, and summary. Returns 0 on success, 1 on blocking failure.

nodes.label: Roadmap P0-P3 Prioritization Matrix
nodes.rationale: P0 security blockers (0-14d), P1 stability/infra (15-30d), P2 quality/normalization (31-60d), P3 experience/validation (61-90d); explicitly forbids microservices, Kubernetes, full rewrite, Stripe integration and iFood scraper integration at current stage to avoid wasted effort.

nodes.label: P0-03: pdvRoutes Missing storeIsolation (Security Gap)
nodes.rationale: Known active security bug: pdvRoutes.js does not include the storeIsolation middleware, so PDV routes lack store scoping; fix is P0 priority in the roadmap.

nodes.label: Socket.io Store Rooms Real-Time Events
nodes.rationale: Real-time events (order:created, order:status, order:paid, kds:item-updated) are emitted to per-store rooms store:<storeId>; clients must emit join:store after auth. Handshake authentication is missing (P0-04).

nodes.label: DEVICE_PENDING_APPROVAL Device Approval Flow
nodes.rationale: New devices are registered as pending on first login and blocked by deviceApproval middleware until an admin approves via GET /api/device/pending + POST /api/device/:id/approve.

nodes.label: Immutable Frozen Config (config.js Object.freeze)
nodes.rationale: config.js is the single centralized config source, exported with Object.freeze so no property can be mutated at runtime; TZ forced to America/Sao_Paulo; CORS_ORIGINS list is shared by Express and Socket.io; SOCKET_CORS_ORIGIN in .env.example is dead/ignored.

nodes.label: Razorpay HMAC-SHA256 Webhook Validation
nodes.rationale: paymentController.js validates the x-razorpay-signature header with HMAC-SHA256 using RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET to guarantee webhook integrity.

nodes.label: Brand Tokens
nodes.rationale: Amber/gold oklch brand tokens replaced generic orange because the project needed a distinct brand identity before the Console migration (Phase 8.5). Defined in @theme inline block for Tailwind v4 class generation.

nodes.label: Inter-Store Transfer
nodes.rationale: Known cosmetic issue at checkpoint time: response had swapped origin/destination store names; underlying data was correct.

nodes.label: Phase 7B Assisted Actions
nodes.rationale: Deliberate principle: NO automation — every operational action requires explicit user click plus confirmation, with double-click protection and cache invalidation after each action.

nodes.label: StockPolicy
nodes.rationale: Delete is a soft-delete (isActive=false); validation is duplicated client-side (before submit) and server-side (mongoose pre-validate hook) with hierarchical rule min<=reorder<=ideal<=max.

nodes.label: interStoreTransferService Bugfix
nodes.rationale: Store.find({$in:[...]}) gives no order guarantee, causing swapped origin/destination names; replaced with Promise.all of two findById calls for deterministic assignment.

nodes.label: Audit Logging
nodes.rationale: logAction() never throws so audit failures cannot break business operations; wired into observability, stock policy and transfer controllers.

nodes.label: Option A Evolve Existing Models
nodes.rationale: Chosen over Option B (new StockImpactRule entity) and Option C (force everything as Recipe) for best cost-benefit ratio: full backward compatibility, medium complexity, fixes the core gap (checkout hard-dependent on Recipe) without polluting the domain.

nodes.label: Recipe Dual Purpose
nodes.rationale: Recipe serves two conflicting purposes: sale consumption recipe (what stock to deduct when selling) and production template (referenced by ProductionBatch.productionRecipe); a 'type' field ('sale' | 'production') was proposed to disambiguate.

nodes.label: stockImpactRule
nodes.rationale: Enum on Product (recipe_composition, stock_item_direct, no_stock_impact, combo_components) that routes checkout stock deduction and CMV; defaults preserve prior behavior (prepared_product + recipe_composition), combo_components exists in enum but returns incomplete_config.

nodes.label: UI Refinements posadmin
nodes.rationale: Dark mode shadows need white glow at very low opacity (1-5%) because black-only shadows are invisible on dark backgrounds; inline styles for dynamic CSS variables are cleaner than dynamic Tailwind class construction.

nodes.label: AST Structural Extraction
nodes.rationale: Deterministic and free: code is extracted structurally with no LLM and no API key, so a code-only corpus needs no semantic pass at all.

nodes.label: Semantic Extraction (Parallel Subagents)
nodes.rationale: Subagents are mandatory because reading files one-by-one is 5-10x slower; all chunks dispatch in a single message to run in parallel.

nodes.label: Semantic Extraction Cache
nodes.rationale: Only uncached files go to subagents, saving tokens on re-runs; stale cache files are deleted so Part C never merges leftovers (#1392).

nodes.label: Community Detection
nodes.rationale: Surfaces cross-document connections the user would not think to ask about.

nodes.label: Graph Health Check
nodes.rationale: Read-only integrity gate that surfaces edge collapse, dangling endpoints, and self-loops - the silent-corruption modes of incremental updates and AST/LLM id mismatches. Never aborts; warnings must be surfaced per the Honesty Rules.

nodes.label: Shrink Guard (#479)
nodes.rationale: to_json refuses to write when the new graph is smaller than the existing graph.json, so an empty or partial extraction never clobbers a good graph, report, or analysis sidecar.

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge; use AMBIGUOUS when unsure; always show token cost and raw cohesion scores; warn before visualizing graphs over 5000 nodes.

nodes.label: Fast Path Query
nodes.source_location: What You Must Do When Invoked
nodes.rationale: When graphify-out/graph.json already exists and the request is a natural-language question, skip the whole build pipeline and run graphify query immediately - the graph is already built.

nodes.label: Gemini Extraction Backend
nodes.rationale: graphify needs no API key; Gemini is used only if GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY is already set, otherwise the host agent itself is the LLM. Never prompt for a key.

nodes.label: Interactive HTML Graph
nodes.rationale: Auto-aggregates to community view if the graph exceeds 5000 nodes.

nodes.label: Watch Mode (--watch)
nodes.rationale: Debounce (default 3s) waits until file activity stops so a wave of parallel agent writes does not trigger a rebuild per file; code-only changes rebuild without an LLM.

nodes.label: Neo4j Export
nodes.rationale: Uses MERGE so pushes are safe to re-run without creating duplicates.

nodes.label: FalkorDB Export
nodes.rationale: FalkorDB's GRAPH.QUERY runs one statement at a time with no bulk script import, so --falkordb-push is preferred over the cypher.txt artifact.

nodes.label: MCP Graph Server
nodes.rationale: Stdio MCP server exposing query_graph, get_node, get_neighbors, get_community, god_nodes, graph_stats, shortest_path so other agents can query the graph live.

nodes.label: Token Reduction Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Runs only when total_words exceeds 5000; for small corpora the graph value is structural clarity, not token compression.

nodes.label: Confidence Score Rubric
nodes.rationale: Discrete values (0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55) replace a continuous range because models collapse range guidance to a binary - production showed a bimodal distribution with >50% at 0.5 and >40% at 0.85+.

nodes.label: Node ID Format
nodes.rationale: Full repo-relative path stems keep same-named files in different directories distinct; IDs must be deterministic from the label alone so the same entity always produces the same ID regardless of which chunk processes it, and must match the AST extractor's IDs to avoid orphan ghost duplicates.

nodes.label: Hyperedges
nodes.rationale: Used sparingly, only when a group relationship among 3+ nodes adds information beyond pairwise edges; max 3 per chunk.

nodes.label: Semantic Similarity Edges
nodes.rationale: Connects concepts that solve the same problem without any structural link; only for genuinely non-obvious, cross-cutting similarity.

nodes.label: GitHub Clone (graphify clone)
nodes.rationale: Clones into ~/.graphify/repos/<owner>/<repo> and reuses existing clones on repeat runs.

nodes.label: Cross-Repo Graph Merge (merge-graphs)
nodes.rationale: Each node in the merged graph carries a repo attribute for filtering by origin; monorepo subfolders use the CLI directly because the skill pipeline would clobber a shared graphify-out/.

nodes.label: Post-Commit Auto-Rebuild Hook
nodes.rationale: Triggers once per commit via git diff HEAD~1 with no background process; appends to an existing post-commit hook rather than replacing it. Doc/image changes are ignored - those need a manual --update.

nodes.label: Native CLAUDE.md Integration
nodes.rationale: Writes a graphify section to CLAUDE.md so Claude checks the graph before answering codebase questions in every future session, without a manual /graphify.

nodes.label: Constrained Query Expansion
nodes.rationale: The query CLI matches via case-folded substring + IDF with no stemming or synonyms, so vocabulary mismatch collapses answers to noise; expansion picks tokens only from the graph's own vocabulary and never invents tokens, keeping the expansion auditable.

nodes.label: BFS Traversal
nodes.rationale: Default mode for broad context - nearest neighbors first, depth 3.

nodes.label: DFS Traversal
nodes.rationale: For tracing a specific chain or dependency path; depth-limited to 6 to avoid traversing the whole graph.

nodes.label: Save-Result Feedback Loop
nodes.rationale: Answers are saved back into the graph so the next --update extracts the Q&A as a node, closing the feedback loop and improving future queries.

nodes.label: Work Memory Lessons (graphify reflect)
nodes.rationale: Outcomes (useful/dead_end/corrected) feed LESSONS.md listing preferred sources, known dead ends, and corrections so future sessions learn from this one; --if-stale keeps session-start refresh nearly free.

nodes.label: Whisper Transcription
nodes.rationale: Video/audio cannot be read directly; transcripts are produced first and then treated as doc files. JSON is written from Python, not a shell redirect, because Whisper progress output would corrupt the file (#1392).

nodes.label: Whisper Domain Hint Prompt
nodes.rationale: The host agent composes a one-sentence domain hint from god node labels itself - no separate API call needed - and exports it as GRAPHIFY_WHISPER_PROMPT for the child process.

nodes.label: Incremental Update (--update)
nodes.rationale: Only re-extracts new or changed files to save tokens and time; deleted files are pruned, and the manifest is saved so the next update diffs against today's state instead of the prior baseline.

nodes.label: build_merge Replace-on-Re-extract
nodes.rationale: Reads graph.json directly without a NetworkX round-trip so edge direction is preserved (#801); every source_file in new chunks is dropped from the base before merge so stale nodes don't survive (#1344); prune_sources is only for genuinely deleted files, and root= relativizes prune paths so pruning actually matches (#1361).

nodes.label: Cluster-Only Rebuild (--cluster-only)
nodes.rationale: Self-contained: re-clusters, names communities, and regenerates outputs from the existing graph. Steps 5-9 must not be re-run because their intermediate files were deleted by a prior cleanup (#1392).

nodes.label: Code-Only Change Detection
nodes.rationale: When all changed files are code, semantic extraction is skipped entirely (no LLM needed); changed video files must be transcribed first or raw media paths get fed to subagents as unreadable input (#1392).

nodes.label: CI Workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs on push/PR to main and dev with permissions minimized to contents: read.

nodes.label: Backend Lint & Test Job
nodes.rationale: Tests use mongodb-memory-server so no external MongoDB (MONGODB_URI) is required in CI; coverage is uploaded as an artifact even on failure.

nodes.label: Backend Structure Validation Job
nodes.rationale: Validates required files exist (app.js, config, .env.example, runbook), verifies .env is not committed, and warns (non-blocking) on package.json test scripts that reference missing test files.

nodes.label: Hardcoded Secret Scan
nodes.rationale: Greps JS/TS sources for the default JWT key placeholder and mongodb+srv connection strings with embedded credentials; fails the build if found.

nodes.label: Admin Panel Build Check Job
nodes.rationale: Runs npx tsc --noEmit before the Next.js build so type errors fail CI even though build might succeed.

nodes.label: Fluxo de Assinatura (Planos, Limites e Billing)
nodes.norm_label: fluxo de assinatura (planos, limites e billing)

nodes.label: Trial (14 dias)
nodes.rationale: Trial expirado bloqueia acesso (dashboard + PDV); notificacao automatica 7 dias antes de expirar para forcar conversao.

nodes.label: Middleware de Limites de Plano
nodes.rationale: Bloqueio ocorre apenas na CRIACAO de recursos (403 LIMIT_EXCEEDED com suggestedPlan), nunca afeta dados existentes — evita punir o cliente por dados legados apos downgrade.

nodes.label: Fluxo de Caixa (Abertura, Movimentacao e Fechamento)
nodes.norm_label: fluxo de caixa (abertura, movimentacao e fechamento)

nodes.label: CashRegister (modelo)
nodes.rationale: Apenas UM caixa aberto por loja por vez; toda venda exige caixa aberto — forca disciplina de rastreabilidade fiscal/contabil brasileira.

nodes.label: Sangria (retirada de dinheiro)
nodes.rationale: Justificativa obrigatoria e valor limitado ao saldo em dinheiro disponivel — rastreabilidade de cada centavo que sai da gaveta.

nodes.label: Fechamento de Caixa (conferencia)
nodes.rationale: Conferencia e APENAS sobre dinheiro fisico (pix/debito/credito conferidos via extrato bancario). Diferenca > R$50 exige aprovacao de supervisor; > R$200 alerta no console operacional.

nodes.label: Fechamento Forcado (cron meia-noite)
nodes.rationale: Cron 23:55 fecha caixas abertos com forced=true e conferencia pendente — evita caixas eternamente abertos quando operador esquece de fechar.

nodes.label: Fluxo de Cardapio (Categorias, Produtos, Variacoes e Fichas Tecnicas)
nodes.norm_label: fluxo de cardapio (categorias, produtos, variacoes e fichas tecnicas)

nodes.label: productReadinessStatus (prontidao para venda)
nodes.rationale: Produto SEMPRE pode ser vendido se isActive:true — falta de ficha tecnica NUNCA bloqueia venda, pois 90% dos restaurantes brasileiros operam sem ficha e o restaurante nao pode parar de vender por configuracao pendente.

nodes.label: Device Fingerprint (SHA-256)
nodes.rationale: Dispositivo novo/nao aprovado ainda permite login em modo somente leitura — nao trava operacao, mas notifica o admin para aprovacao.

nodes.label: Integracao iFood (Partner API)
nodes.rationale: iFood domina 70%+ do mercado brasileiro de delivery — a integracao e prioridade maxima, nao opcional; pedido iFood chega com pagamento ja processado.

nodes.label: Delivery Proprio (WhatsApp/telefone)
nodes.rationale: Sem comissao de marketplace; taxa de entrega configurada por bairro (nao por distancia) — pratica do setor.

nodes.label: Inventario (contagem fisica)
nodes.rationale: Inventario fisico e a UNICA fonte da verdade e sempre sobrescreve o calculado — baixa automatica acumula erro (porcoes nao padronizadas) e o estoque calculado degrada com o tempo.

nodes.label: Baixa Automatica por Venda
nodes.rationale: So funciona se TODOS os produtos tem recipe; NUNCA travar venda por falta de estoque — restaurante real nao opera assim.

nodes.norm_label: fluxo fiscal (nfc-e, sat, cpf na nota)

nodes.label: NFC-e (Nota Fiscal ao Consumidor eletronica)
nodes.rationale: NFC-e pode ser emitida em LOTE no fim do dia (mesma data) — nao precisa ser online no momento da venda; cancelamento ate 30 min apos autorizacao.

nodes.label: Cupom Nao-Fiscal (MEI)
nodes.rationale: MEI (faturamento < R$81.000/ano) pode operar sem NFC-e: cupom interno + contador emite NF-e global mensal — MVP de custo zero.

nodes.label: CPF na Nota (incentivos estaduais)
nodes.rationale: CPF e OPCIONAL — nunca travar a venda; incluido apenas quando o consumidor quer beneficios (Nota Parana, Nota Fiscal Paulista etc.).

nodes.label: Emissao Fiscal em Lote (fim do dia)
nodes.norm_label: emissao fiscal em lote (fim do dia)

nodes.label: Impressora Termica (ESC/POS)
nodes.rationale: Papel ainda reina (~70% das cozinhas): mais barato, resistente a gordura/calor, instantaneo e garante o pedido fisico — impressora e PRIORIDADE, KDS e complemento.

nodes.label: Tela KDS (Kitchen Display)
nodes.rationale: KDS serve mais ao GESTOR (metricas, gargalos, SLA) do que ao cozinheiro — cozinheiro nao interage com timer.

nodes.label: storeIsolation (middleware de tenant)
nodes.rationale: Isolamento garantido por middleware + storeId obrigatorio em TODAS as queries MongoDB e indices compostos — nenhum dado de uma loja pode vazar para outra.

nodes.label: Clonagem de Configuracao de Loja
nodes.rationale: Clona apenas configuracao (categorias, produtos, recipes, roles); NUNCA copia dados transacionais (pedidos, estoque, usuarios).

nodes.label: Maquininha (Stone/Cielo/Rede/GetNet)
nodes.rationale: A maquininha e INDEPENDENTE do POS — em ~70% dos restaurantes o POS apenas REGISTRA o resultado que o garcom digita (nivel 0 manual); gateway online e excecao, nao regra.

nodes.label: PIX (estatico, dinamico, link)
nodes.rationale: QR estatico com confirmacao manual e o padrao para pequenos (sem custo de gateway); QR dinamico com webhook so para delivery/automacao (~0,99% por transacao).

nodes.label: Pagamento Misto (multiplas transacoes)
nodes.rationale: Pagamento misto e REGRA no Brasil, nao excecao — o modelo de pagamento usa array de transactions por pedido.

nodes.label: Garcom (ator central do fluxo)
nodes.rationale: No restaurante brasileiro o pedido comeca no garcom (nao no operador de caixa) — ele cria, serve e fecha; o fluxo do sistema reflete essa realidade de salao.

nodes.label: Pre-Conta
nodes.rationale: Etapa obrigatoria antes do pagamento (costume brasileiro): cliente confere, pode pedir ajustes, e a pre-conta NAO altera status do pedido.

nodes.label: Gorjeta 10% (taxa de servico)
nodes.rationale: 90% dos restaurantes incluem o 10% por padrao na conta, removivel a pedido do cliente; distribuida entre garcons no fim do mes.

nodes.label: Couvert Artistico
nodes.rationale: So pode ser cobrado se o cliente ACEITOU (Sumula 627 STJ) e nao entra no calculo do 10%.

nodes.label: Status do Pedido (maquina de estados)
nodes.rationale: Pedido 'completed' NAO significa mesa fechada — a mesa acumula N pedidos e so fecha no pagamento (closeStatus).

nodes.label: No-Show
nodes.rationale: Registrado apos 30 min do horario; 3 no-shows consecutivos bloqueiam o cliente de novas reservas — protege ocupacao das mesas.

nodes.label: RBAC (dois niveis: cargo legado + Role granular)
nodes.rationale: Sistema convive com cargos legados em string (Admin/Caixa/Garcom) e permissoes granulares via modelo Role — checkPermission aceita ambos para compatibilidade.
nodes.norm_label: rbac (dois niveis: cargo legado + role granular)

nodes.label: Comissao de Garcom (commissionRate)
nodes.rationale: Comissao vinculada ao attendant do pedido; na transferencia de mesa a comissao original e mantida (nao migra para o novo garcom).

nodes.label: Decision: Centralized storeIsolation Middleware
nodes.rationale: Multiple stores share one MongoDB instance; centralized middleware injects req.storeId/req.store and helpers (getStoreFilter, applyStoreToAggregation) so controllers cannot omit tenant filtering. Separate DB per tenant rejected (operational cost), separate schema rejected (Mongoose limitations), manual per-controller filtering rejected (error-prone). Known gap: pdvRoutes.js omits the middleware.

nodes.label: ADR-0002: MongoDB Transactions for Stock Deduction
nodes.norm_label: adr-0002: mongodb transactions for stock deduction

nodes.label: Decision: MongoDB Sessions (ACID) for Checkout Stock Deduction
nodes.rationale: Stock deduction spans multiple writes (balances, StockMovement, COGS, Order); transactions guarantee all-or-nothing. Session is created in the controller and passed to processOrderStockDeduction so cross-domain operations can share one transaction. Hard errors abort; soft errors (product without recipe) only flag. Requires Replica Set (Atlas). Message queue and manual compensation rejected.
nodes.norm_label: decision: mongodb sessions (acid) for checkout stock deduction

nodes.label: Decision: JWT in httpOnly Secure SameSite Cookie
nodes.rationale: Protects the token from XSS (localStorage/sessionStorage rejected as script-accessible). SameSite none+Secure enables cross-origin SPA/Next.js clients. Known asymmetry: cookie maxAge 30d vs JWT expiresIn 1d requires a future refresh-token endpoint. tokenVerification.js also accepts Authorization Bearer header.
nodes.norm_label: decision: jwt in httponly secure samesite cookie

nodes.label: Decision: RBAC via Role Documents (ObjectId) with Legacy String Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Roles as MongoDB documents allow per-store customization of module/action permissions without redeploy; hardcoded enums and ABAC rejected. userModel.role uses Mixed type accepting ObjectId (new) and String (legacy 'Admin'/'Gerente') as a transitional measure; legacy path is a bypass risk and must be removed after full migration. checkPermission(module, action) supports both formats.
nodes.norm_label: decision: rbac via role documents (objectid) with legacy string compatibility

nodes.label: Decision: Non-blocking Fire-and-Forget Operational Audit
nodes.rationale: auditService catches all exceptions and returns null so an audit-write failure never blocks a critical business operation (e.g. a real stock transfer). Blocking audit rejected for operational impact; async queue (Bull/Redis) rejected as premature infrastructure. Trade-off: no retry, silent-failure risk mitigated by console error logs and future monitoring.
